S.FORM: == H2 " manga a nikulitan" H2 == "H2" ci An-ta-cun kina misangaay tina nu Dipun a mangaan. ina ka kungkuan u Kaw-cung nu miyakiway ku sasasulitan, itida tu i tusaay nu tatami atu tataynaan, nina sepatay a tademawan itida i sakasungaay atu nikasasumidangan a nikatahekalan nu kakungkuan. "H2" a daymukan nu kakungkuan tu ninatatusaay a tatamaan nu sakasinganganan. ci Kuo-cin-pi-li nu ngangan, nu Dipun a sasakamuen "HIRO" nu igu a kamuan "HERO", i Cin-cun kawcung piyakiwan u wanpay miwaitay. duma a tatamaan han ci Ciaw-ing-sun "HIDEO", i Min-he-yi piyakiwan u samatinengay misetulay. nina tusaay a micudaday caay kaw malecaday ku nipicudad i kawcung, caay kalecad ku pimalian, mangalay a micumud i Ciaw-ce-yen sisa masasetset sa. "H2" ."H2" "HIRO"是取英語"HERO"的諧音, (HIDEO), . ina tatusaay a cabayan sa caay kalecad ku nipikawcungan, nu nikapicudadan ni Kuo-cin-pi-li tu kawcung patelac ku nipimelaw nu misaydan tu imelang nida, sisa ci Kuo-cin-pi-li acaay tu kaku piyakiw sa, sisa mipili' ci nida tu nayi'ay nu miyakiway a cacudadan nu kawcung, nikatinengan satu tu nikapatelac nu misaydan, itida satu patideng tu manamuhay nu micudaday a tademaw tu piyakiwan nu masakaputay, malasakakaay nu miwaitay tu malian. sisa " H2" inaimi han " tusaay ingsyung" . musakamu tu i yayakiwan nu nikasasetsetan, i hekal han u masasungaayay ku nu heni a tatusa. ina ka kungkuan nu hedek u sakapahay a melawan itini i Ciaw-ce-yen a nikasasetsetan nu malian. .所以"H2" . Kuo-cin-pi-li 國見比呂 Pilecuhan: cacay bulad sabaw enem demiad. Cin-cun cacudadan nu piyakiwan wanpay miwaitay, naw Cin-na cungsye nu wanpay miwaitay, nipatelacan nu misaydang, sisa pili' satu ci nida tu inai'ay nu yakiwan a picudadan. likeluh saca tu ci Ku-he-cun-haw atu misaydang tu mapaadih satu, atu ci Ye-ten-dun paytem sa patideng tu Cin-cun cacudadan tu piyakiwan nu likisian, sakatulu ku pibataan nida, sakapahay nida a mibata', idaw ku "hidawhaw anta cewan" nu pinganganan. ci Pi-ci insiyung ku matinengay ci Yi-kun-ya-lin, misuayaw ci Yi-kun-ya-li acu Ku-he-cun-haw idaw ku ngalay, misuayaw tina tusaay a ngalay nai' ku watan. 生日:1月16日. . Ci-in-siung 橘英雄 pailecuhan: sabaw cacay bulad enem demiad. matinengay nu misetulay tu yakiaw a tademaw ci Min-he-yi-kaw, hina i balucu'en nida ku ci lian tu caycin anta tu nikakapahan. micudad henay i Cin-na-cun-sye sikayan ni Kuo-cin-pi-li tu ci Yi-kun-ya-lin. luma' ni Ci-in-siung u tataydaan nina sapatay a tademaw ci Pi-li,Ten-ye, Ya-lin kalecapuan, u aadihan ni Pi,Ya-ten tu cudadan. 生日:11月6日. . Ye-kun-ya-lin 雨宮雅玲 pilecuhan: walu bulad sabaw enem demiad. sakapahay nu biyawan a cabayan ci Pi-li, nika kaadihan ni Pi-li ku nisacabayan, sipasiwkay han ci Ci-ing-siung, malamamidang tu ni In-syung, nika ida i balucu ku ngalay ci Pi-lian idaw henay ku ngalay ci Pi-lian. 41 pilecuhan: tulu bulad tulu demiad. sakapahay ni Pi-li micudad i kawcung, manamuh ci Pi-lian. kakahan u Cin-cun cacudadan nu miyakiway a ciawlien. ci Pi-li itida i kuse ni ama nida mikuli, kalaapaapaan ku wayway, kilul han kina ka kungkuan u masatatungusay nu tataynaan, manamuh ci Pi-lian. 生日:3月3日. . Ye-ten-tun 野田敦 atu ci Kuo-cin sakakapahay a maaedaw nu midakepay tu malaian, i piyakiwan nu " acawa" ni Pi-li, sakalecad ni Pi-li kapatelacan nu misaydan ci nida sisa tayda i nai'ay nu miyakiway a cacudadan i Cin-cun-kaw-siaw. ci Ciaw-cen caay kaw kalawkaway nika kahemekan ku icelang, piyakiwan u sakasepat nu mibataay, caay ka lawlaw ku balucu, nika i katuuday matineng pakatawa tu katuuday. . Mu-ken-lung-tay-lang 木根龍太郎 Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu mitukuday atu miyakiway tu mali a kaputan, yu micudad tu nu wawaan milabu tu Pay-san-ten-se kaput sa atu Ci-ing-siung maalaw tu sapibataan mademec inai' ku nabalucuan, itini satu pikuocungan milabu tu mitukuday malamitukuday nu hinaalaay tu tinsuan, hinaalaala ku balucu'. micudad satu tu kawcung maala nu picudadan nu Sin-sin piyakiwan milihida milabu, mala sakay hekal nu midakepay tu malian atu sakacacay nu mibata'ay, malecad mala sakatusa nu miwaitay tu malian, u mamuculil tu tulu a nipitepatepaan nu kapahay a kaputan. Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway, wawa nu Cin-cun-kaw-siaw a sasaydan, matineng mikulit. naw mapatay nu linges nu wama nikasasakamuan anu micudad satu kawcung a caay tu pimalisa, nika caay ka pawan ci nida tu yakiwan atu nikasasetsetan tu ci Cie-mi-he-yi-kaw, sadikuday alaw mihang ku wama ci nidaan papilabu tu piyakiwan, saniked han a miedap pasipasip tu kulul. itini i piyakiwan mala sakatusa nu midakepay tu malian atu sakatusa nu pibata'an, u misaicelangay nu mibata'ay a tademwan. Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway, cabay ni Ci, mikisaba tu cacay nu mihcaan ci Cian. wawa henay ci Ing-syung baliwsan mabahel ku tupel nida mahetik i sauwac, ci kaka ni Cuo-cun miedap a miala tiya tupelan, caay ka kapah ku nipikapet malikid i balabaladan mapatay. picudadan tu kawcung cacay a mihcaan mala sakaenem nu mibataday, micudad satu tusa a mihcaan taydan i sakalima nu mibataday atu midayli ci Mu-ken tu sakacacay nu mibata'day, sayaway ka adihan ci Ta-cu aci Taw-siw nu micumuday a tademawan. . Ta-cu-wen-syung 大竹文雄 Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway a kaputan. yu mahida inai' ku piyakiwan nida a kawawan, nika icelang a minanam idaw ku nikacelakan nida tu tanayuay a nipibata'an, sisa hatidaay nu kaputan u kawanan nu midakepay tu mali atu sakacacay nu midakepay tu malian. micudaday nu miyakiway, atu ci Kun-ten, Ta-cu u malalalumaan ku nu heni, apuyu ku udip, naw u madubaay ci nida sa. sitadah ci ama nida sisa yukiwan ni Kun-ten, atu ci Ta-cu milabu i Cin-cun piyakiwan mala misetulay a tademaw, u sapipacuis tu tadahan, mipili' ci nida u nipacukulay sa alaw u mihantayay ci Kun-ten. ci Ciaw-cen u saamelikay nina miyakiway a tademaw, matineng misetul tu nikasasumadsumad nu malian, ilabuhan malakawanan nu midkepay tu malian. sayaway nu Cin-cun cacudadan nu ciawleyn, kaka ni Cun-haw, si ngisngis atu kasimiganian tu lumeniay ku wayway nida, mahida u maedesay a melawan, ala han ku migani katawaan sa kiya mata. dawmi' ku balucu', matinengay mililiday tu micudaday a saydangan. saan " itini nipicudadan tu Kaw-cung u sapatahekal tu wayway a kakitidaan, caay kaw sakaaalaw atu ciwlin sa". saan kapah ku nipimelaw tu nipiyakiwan sa, alaw han caay kaw masahicahicaay, sawsawni supa'en nu miyakiway a micudaday. . Liw-sasaydang 柳校長 Cin-cun cacudadan nu sasaydang, ci ama ni Suo-taw. yu micudad henay ci nida sawni edisan ci nida, sakasikadan sa nu cacudadan, nau sakanamuhan nida ku yakiw alaw u patay nu linges ci nida tu yakiwan. ci Pen-yi-ci-min aci Yi-kaw atu Cin-cun cacudadan masasetset tu yakiw, u Ay-haw a nikademec ku han, pacicien a mikaysang. nipalekalan nu Ay-haw-se tu nikasasetsetan a malalum, miduyi tu Ay-haw-huy patideng tu miyakiway, paayaw kina Cin-cun cacudadan tu piyakiwan a kakitidaan. kapah ku mata nu sasaydang, cinida ku makaadihay tu Ay-haw-huy atu nikasasetsetan tu Min-hean, pacebasa ku saybang tu Cin-cun cacudadan mademec kamu sa hedek satu kina nipiyakiwan nu Cin-cun cacudadan. . Kaun-ten-sen-li 廣田勝利 Pae-tun-cin miyakiway a cacudadan nu matinengay miwait a tademaw u mamisetulay tu sakasepat, patisuan ni Ye-ten "caay pikaka tu tineng ci Lian", nika matineng sibalucu', hina i kakadubaan atu hekal matineng idaw ku pacebaay a waywyan, hina tiyun hananay a malil mawait ku ciku nu lima ni Ci-ingan, patayda aca ci Ta-cu aci Daw-cin micumud i Cin-san-cun yakiwan mala i labuay mademec, nikudan satu i sadingsingan nu nikasasetsetan misuayaw ci Cin-cun masasetset tuci Zen-ke-kuo-cin nu tinengan, masasetset a tatusa, nikasasetset satu, pihaceng ku adada nu lima sisa ales han nida ku mamiwait tu mali a kawawan. .

"H2" ."H2" "HIRO"是取英語"HERO"的諧音, (HIDEO), . ina tatusaay a cabayan sa caay kalecad ku nipikawcungan, nu nikapicudadan ni Kuo-cin-pi-li tu kawcung patelac ku nipimelaw nu misaydan tu imelang nida, sisa ci Kuo-cin-pi-li acaay tu kaku piyakiw sa, sisa mipili' ci nida tu nayi'ay nu miyakiway a cacudadan nu kawcung, nikatinengan satu tu nikapatelac nu misaydan, itida satu patideng tu manamuhay nu micudaday a tademaw tu piyakiwan nu masakaputay, malasakakaay nu miwaitay tu malian. sisa " H2" inaimi han " tusaay ingsyung" . musakamu tu i yayakiwan nu nikasasetsetan, i hekal han u masasungaayay ku nu heni a tatusa. ina ka kungkuan nu hedek u sakapahay a melawan itini i Ciaw-ce-yen a nikasasetsetan nu malian. .所以"H2" . Kuo-cin-pi-li 國見比呂 Pilecuhan: cacay bulad sabaw enem demiad. Cin-cun cacudadan nu piyakiwan wanpay miwaitay, naw Cin-na cungsye nu wanpay miwaitay, nipatelacan nu misaydang, sisa pili' satu ci nida tu inai'ay nu yakiwan a picudadan. likeluh saca tu ci Ku-he-cun-haw atu misaydang tu mapaadih satu, atu ci Ye-ten-dun paytem sa patideng tu Cin-cun cacudadan tu piyakiwan nu likisian, sakatulu ku pibataan nida, sakapahay nida a mibata', idaw ku "hidawhaw anta cewan" nu pinganganan. ci Pi-ci insiyung ku matinengay ci Yi-kun-ya-lin, misuayaw ci Yi-kun-ya-li acu Ku-he-cun-haw idaw ku ngalay, misuayaw tina tusaay a ngalay nai' ku watan. 生日:1月16日. . Ci-in-siung 橘英雄 pailecuhan: sabaw cacay bulad enem demiad. matinengay nu misetulay tu yakiaw a tademaw ci Min-he-yi-kaw, hina i balucu'en nida ku ci lian tu caycin anta tu nikakapahan. micudad henay i Cin-na-cun-sye sikayan ni Kuo-cin-pi-li tu ci Yi-kun-ya-lin. luma' ni Ci-in-siung u tataydaan nina sapatay a tademaw ci Pi-li,Ten-ye, Ya-lin kalecapuan, u aadihan ni Pi,Ya-ten tu cudadan. 生日:11月6日. . Ye-kun-ya-lin 雨宮雅玲 pilecuhan: walu bulad sabaw enem demiad. sakapahay nu biyawan a cabayan ci Pi-li, nika kaadihan ni Pi-li ku nisacabayan, sipasiwkay han ci Ci-ing-siung, malamamidang tu ni In-syung, nika ida i balucu ku ngalay ci Pi-lian idaw henay ku ngalay ci Pi-lian. 41 pilecuhan: tulu bulad tulu demiad. sakapahay ni Pi-li micudad i kawcung, manamuh ci Pi-lian. kakahan u Cin-cun cacudadan nu miyakiway a ciawlien. ci Pi-li itida i kuse ni ama nida mikuli, kalaapaapaan ku wayway, kilul han kina ka kungkuan u masatatungusay nu tataynaan, manamuh ci Pi-lian. 生日:3月3日. . Ye-ten-tun 野田敦 atu ci Kuo-cin sakakapahay a maaedaw nu midakepay tu malaian, i piyakiwan nu " acawa" ni Pi-li, sakalecad ni Pi-li kapatelacan nu misaydan ci nida sisa tayda i nai'ay nu miyakiway a cacudadan i Cin-cun-kaw-siaw. ci Ciaw-cen caay kaw kalawkaway nika kahemekan ku icelang, piyakiwan u sakasepat nu mibataay, caay ka lawlaw ku balucu, nika i katuuday matineng pakatawa tu katuuday. . Mu-ken-lung-tay-lang 木根龍太郎 Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu mitukuday atu miyakiway tu mali a kaputan, yu micudad tu nu wawaan milabu tu Pay-san-ten-se kaput sa atu Ci-ing-siung maalaw tu sapibataan mademec inai' ku nabalucuan, itini satu pikuocungan milabu tu mitukuday malamitukuday nu hinaalaay tu tinsuan, hinaalaala ku balucu'. micudad satu tu kawcung maala nu picudadan nu Sin-sin piyakiwan milihida milabu, mala sakay hekal nu midakepay tu malian atu sakacacay nu mibata'ay, malecad mala sakatusa nu miwaitay tu malian, u mamuculil tu tulu a nipitepatepaan nu kapahay a kaputan. Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway, wawa nu Cin-cun-kaw-siaw a sasaydan, matineng mikulit. naw mapatay nu linges nu wama nikasasakamuan anu micudad satu kawcung a caay tu pimalisa, nika caay ka pawan ci nida tu yakiwan atu nikasasetsetan tu ci Cie-mi-he-yi-kaw, sadikuday alaw mihang ku wama ci nidaan papilabu tu piyakiwan, saniked han a miedap pasipasip tu kulul. itini i piyakiwan mala sakatusa nu midakepay tu malian atu sakatusa nu pibata'an, u misaicelangay nu mibata'ay a tademwan. Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway, cabay ni Ci, mikisaba tu cacay nu mihcaan ci Cian. wawa henay ci Ing-syung baliwsan mabahel ku tupel nida mahetik i sauwac, ci kaka ni Cuo-cun miedap a miala tiya tupelan, caay ka kapah ku nipikapet malikid i balabaladan mapatay. picudadan tu kawcung cacay a mihcaan mala sakaenem nu mibataday, micudad satu tusa a mihcaan taydan i sakalima nu mibataday atu midayli ci Mu-ken tu sakacacay nu mibata'day, sayaway ka adihan ci Ta-cu aci Taw-siw nu micumuday a tademawan. . Ta-cu-wen-syung 大竹文雄 Cin-cun-kaw-siaw nu miyakiway a kaputan. yu mahida inai' ku piyakiwan nida a kawawan, nika icelang a minanam idaw ku nikacelakan nida tu tanayuay a nipibata'an, sisa hatidaay nu kaputan u kawanan nu midakepay tu mali atu sakacacay nu midakepay tu malian. micudaday nu miyakiway, atu ci Kun-ten, Ta-cu u malalalumaan ku nu heni, apuyu ku udip, naw u madubaay ci nida sa. sitadah ci ama nida sisa yukiwan ni Kun-ten, atu ci Ta-cu milabu i Cin-cun piyakiwan mala misetulay a tademaw, u sapipacuis tu tadahan, mipili' ci nida u nipacukulay sa alaw u mihantayay ci Kun-ten. ci Ciaw-cen u saamelikay nina miyakiway a tademaw, matineng misetul tu nikasasumadsumad nu malian, ilabuhan malakawanan nu midkepay tu malian. sayaway nu Cin-cun cacudadan nu ciawleyn, kaka ni Cun-haw, si ngisngis atu kasimiganian tu lumeniay ku wayway nida, mahida u maedesay a melawan, ala han ku migani katawaan sa kiya mata. dawmi' ku balucu', matinengay mililiday tu micudaday a saydangan. saan " itini nipicudadan tu Kaw-cung u sapatahekal tu wayway a kakitidaan, caay kaw sakaaalaw atu ciwlin sa". saan kapah ku nipimelaw tu nipiyakiwan sa, alaw han caay kaw masahicahicaay, sawsawni supa'en nu miyakiway a micudaday. . Liw-sasaydang 柳校長 Cin-cun cacudadan nu sasaydang, ci ama ni Suo-taw. yu micudad henay ci nida sawni edisan ci nida, sakasikadan sa nu cacudadan, nau sakanamuhan nida ku yakiw alaw u patay nu linges ci nida tu yakiwan. ci Pen-yi-ci-min aci Yi-kaw atu Cin-cun cacudadan masasetset tu yakiw, u Ay-haw a nikademec ku han, pacicien a mikaysang. nipalekalan nu Ay-haw-se tu nikasasetsetan a malalum, miduyi tu Ay-haw-huy patideng tu miyakiway, paayaw kina Cin-cun cacudadan tu piyakiwan a kakitidaan. kapah ku mata nu sasaydang, cinida ku makaadihay tu Ay-haw-huy atu nikasasetsetan tu Min-hean, pacebasa ku saybang tu Cin-cun cacudadan mademec kamu sa hedek satu kina nipiyakiwan nu Cin-cun cacudadan. .
